parameters.name: BasicRules
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Basic Policies. Valid values:

- **1**: Enable.

- **0**: shutdown.

parameters.name: CtiRules
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable threat intelligence. Valid values:

- **1**: Enable.

- **0**: Disable.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MaxSdl
parameters.description: The daily traffic limit for sensitive data detection.

parameters.name: PatchRules
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable virtual patches. Valid values:

- **1**: Enable.

- **0**: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleClass
parameters.description:
The IPS rules group. Valid values:

- **1**: Loose rule group.

- **2**: Medium rule group.

- **3**: Strict rule group.

parameters.name: RunMode
parameters.description:
The IPS defense mode. Valid values:

- **1**: Block Mode.

- **0**: monitor mode.
